data.title: Holladay Distillery Helps Bring Made for KC Barbecue Championship to Weston
data.description: Top competition teams from the region have gathered in Weston, Missouri for the high-stakes barbecue championship. Taking place in historic Weston, Missouri, the 4th Annual Made for KC BBQ Championship is attracting attention in Kansas City. The event, featuring the region's finest teams, commenced on August 21, 2026.

data.title: Rent the Runway to Report Second Quarter 2026 Results on September 11, 2026
data.description: Rent the Runway, Inc. is set to announce its financial results for the second quarter of 2026 on September 11, 2026. The results will cover the period up to July 31, 2026, and will be publicized before the market opens. The company, listed as RENT on Nasdaq, will conduct a pre-recorded conference call and webcast at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time on the same day to discuss the financial outcomes and offer insights into its business operations.

data.title: ENCORE BOSTON HARBOR TEAMSTERS OVERWHELMINGLY AUTHORIZE STRIKE
data.description: In Everett, Massachusetts, on August 21, 2026, more than 1,300 employees at Encore Boston Harbor have given a resounding 97% approval for a potential work stoppage. The workers, who are represented by Teamsters Local 25 and UNITE HERE Local 26, are demanding fair wages. Teamsters Local 25, representing 211 workers, is a part of this movement.

data.title: United Fire Group, Inc. declares quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share and announces new board appointment
data.description: In Cedar Rapids, Iowa on August 21, 2026, the board of directors of United Fire Group, Inc. (UFG) announced a quarterly cash dividend of $0.20 per share for their common stock (Nasdaq: UFCS). Shareholders of record as of September 4, 2026, will receive the payout on September 18, 2026.

data.title: Armor Health Deploys ACE Geriatric Model of Care at Franklin County Ohio Correctional Facilities -- Believed to Be a First in Correctional Healthcare
data.description: Today, on August 21, 2026, Armor Health, a prominent national provider of correctional healthcare services, revealed that they have introduced the Acute Care for Elders (ACE) model at the Franklin County Correctional Facilities based in Miami. This initiative aims to improve healthcare services for elderly inmates. Armor Health is known for its extensive experience in providing healthcare solutions for correctional facilities, and this recent deployment of the ACE model signifies a significant step towards bettering the medical care provided to aging inmates.

data.title: Storelocal Storage Expands Footprint With Four New Self-Storage Locations
data.description: In a recent press release dated August 21, 2026, Storelocal Storage revealed the launch of four additional self-storage sites, further enhancing its collection of safe and well-kept facilities in California and Tennessee. The fresh locations situated in Prunedale, Cameron Park, and Oakdale signify an expansion in the company's offerings, solidifying its presence in the storage sector.

data.title: Tickets Now on Sale for The Moonwalkers: A Journey with Tom Hanks at South Florida PBS
data.description: Get ready, South Florida residents! An immersive experience, The Moonwalkers: A Journey with Tom Hanks, has arrived, offering a unique opportunity to explore the Moon. MIAMI, Aug. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- South Florida PBS has revealed that ticket sales for this event will begin on Thursday, August 20th. Don't miss your chance to be a part of this groundbreaking experience.

data.title: Stateside Associates Names Johnathan Lozier President as Mark Anderson Transitions to Chairman
data.description: Announcing its strategic plans for future growth and expansion, Stateside Associates, a leading state and local government relations firm, based in Washington, revealed a planned leadership transition on August 21, 2026. The firm is preparing for its next phase of growth through tech-enabled consulting services and a nationwide expansion effort. This move signifies a significant milestone for the organization as it aims to strengthen its presence across the country and enhance its services.

data.title: FDA Authorizes ZYN ULTRA Nicotine Pouches Following Scientific Review
data.description: In Stamford, CT, Philip Morris International Inc. (NYSE: PM) revealed that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has provided Marketing Granted Orders to PMI's U.S. affiliate, Swedish Match USA, Inc., approving the marketing of 11 ZYN ULTRA moist oral nicotine pouch products. This includes all 9mg variants and one 11mg variant, while more 11mg variants are still being reviewed scientifically. This move strengthens PMI's position as a leader in the smoke-free sector.

data.title: NurExone Announces Annual General and Special Meeting to Consider Share Consolidation in Support of U.S. Capital Markets Strategy
data.description: A share consolidation plan of up to a ratio of 30:1 has been proposed with the aim of facilitating a potential listing on a U.S. stock exchange and expanding attractiveness to investors. This move is intended to streamline the company's shares and possibly increase share value, making it more appealing to a broader pool of investors.

data.title: Meghan Markle in talks to join Season 3 of Netflix's "The Gentlemen," but it's not confirmed yet.
data.description: According to sources, there have been preliminary discussions between the representatives of the duchess and the producers regarding her potential involvement in a third season of “The Gentlemen.” However, it is important to note that Netflix has not officially approved the production of a third season of the series at this time.

data.title: These Copper Miners Top Buy Points Amid Supply, Demand Crunch
data.description: The price of copper is currently close to all-time highs, with global copper sources facing strain. Several copper miners are reaching top buy points amidst a challenging situation with supply and demand.

data.title: Impinj Set To Revolutionize Logistics With Tracking Chips. CEO Eyes 'Gigantic Opportunity.'
data.description: The CEO of Impinj, a company specializing in chips and systems for asset tracking, believes the company is at the beginning of its growth path. Impinj is poised to revolutionize logistics through tracking chips, with the CEO identifying a significant opportunity ahead.

data.title: Google's Paige Bailey outlines 'Full-Stack AI' as a unified system from infrastructure to user interfaces, reflecting a rise in integrated AI platforms.
data.description: Paige Bailey from Google recently highlighted the concept of 'full-stack AI', which refers to a comprehensive system that covers infrastructure to user interfaces. This signals a growing trend in the development of AI platforms that are integrated and holistic.

data.title: Binance introduces Agent OS to integrate AI agents with trading, payments, and on-chain functions for its financial super app.
data.description: Binance introduces Agent OS to link AI programs to its trading, payments, and on-chain functions, bolstering its financial super app concept. This move aims to optimize performance and accessibility for users, offering a seamless experience across various services. With this launch, Binance further solidifies its position as a leading financial platform, showcasing its commitment to innovation and customer satisfaction.

data.title: Algorand (ALGO) 5.0 launches Falcon-1024 for post-quantum signatures, boosting security and scalability. #crypto #blockchain
data.description: The latest update of Algorand, version 5.0, includes the integration of native post-quantum signatures using Falcon-1024, aiming to boost blockchain security and scalability for developers. This development is crucial in safeguarding the platform against potential threats in the future, ensuring the protection of user data and transactions.
